title: qsrv / Overview
description: Health, queues, storage, backups and HTTP of qsrv.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.description: The part of queue names before the slash.

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape qsrv.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: qsrv version, SQLite driver (cgo or WASM) and Go version: hover the value.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: qsrv alerts firing now (from deploy/prometheus/alerts.yml).

panels.title: Waiting
panels.description: Messages in the selected queues not being processed: ready, delayed, or waiting behind their ordering group.

panels.title: Oldest message
panels.description: Longest any message has waited, over the selected queues, dead letter queues excluded. Above 5m (amber) or 1h (red), something is not being consumed.

targets.expr: max(qsrv_queue_oldest_message_age_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", queue=~"$queue"} unless on (queue) qsrv:dlq:is_dlq) or vector(0)

panels.title: Oldest message age
panels.description: Per queue (dead letter queues excluded). The most useful signal: a line that only goes up is a queue nobody consumes, or a group blocked by a failing message.

panels.title: Messages by queue
panels.description: Live messages (ready, delayed, in flight, waiting) per queue.

panels.title: Messages by state
panels.description: ready: deliverable now. delayed: scheduled or backing off after a failure. in_flight: leased to a consumer. waiting: behind the head of its ordering group.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Messages per second sent, delivered (including redeliveries) and acked.

panels.title: Failures
panels.description: nacked: a consumer reported a failure. expired: a lease ran out (consumer crashed or too slow). dead_lettered: retries exhausted, moved to the DLQ. dropped: retries exhausted, no DLQ. retention_expired: waited longer than the queue's retention, deleted unprocessed.

panels.title: Dead letter queues
panels.description: Messages waiting in dead letter queues: failures someone has to look at (admin UI, or qctl replay). Needs the recording rule in alerts.yml.

targets.expr: sum by (queue) (qsrv_queue_messages{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", queue=~"$queue"}) and on (queue) qsrv:dlq:is_dlq

panels.title: Queues now
panels.description: Current state of every selected queue. Click a queue for its own dashboard.

panels.title: Commit latency
panels.description: Transaction + fsync. Every send and ack waits for it: this is the disk's health. A few ms on SSD; tens of ms on network disks.

panels.title: Group commit
panels.description: Operations share transactions and fsyncs when they arrive together. More ops per commit = the disk is busy and batching works.

panels.title: Writes waiting for the disk
panels.description: Operations queued for the writer. Sustained above 0 means the disk can't keep up.

panels.title: Disk
panels.description: Free space on the data dir's filesystem, and where it is heading. Below -min-free-disk qsrv refuses new messages.

targets.legendFormat: free in 3 days at this rate

panels.title: Database files
panels.description: qsrv.db (live messages + history of persistent queues) and its WAL. A growing WAL means checkpoints are blocked by a long reader.

panels.title: Refusing sends (disk low)
panels.description: 1 while free disk is below -min-free-disk: sends get 503 storage_full, consumers keep draining.

panels.title: Last snapshot
panels.description: How long ago the last complete snapshot was taken. No data: snapshots are off (-backup-dir) or none finished yet.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: 429: a queue is full (max_messages). 503: shutting down or storage_full. 500: internal error, check the logs.

panels.title: Latency p99 by route
panels.description: Receive is left out: with long polling it waits on purpose.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, route) (rate(qsrv_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route!~".*/receive"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Grows with live messages (~200 B each), not with history or body size.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Roughly one per open connection or long poll.
